declarations.name: model
declarations.purpose: Immutable pure Data Transfer Object (DTO) or boundary representation
declarations.rules: Models cannot declare methods or internal mutable state. Used for API payloads and validation.

declarations.name: entity
declarations.rules: Must reside strictly in entities/ directory. Cannot be returned directly to HTTP callers (use DTO).

declarations.name: class
declarations.purpose: Stateful service, repository, or actor implementation
declarations.rules: Must implement constructor injection via `init(...)`. Direct database instantiation is banned.

declarations.name: interface
declarations.purpose: Contract specification for repositories and external services
